title: Face-Adaptive Joint Confidence Regions for Survivor-Complier Benefit Intervals
banked_reason: The advertised support-adaptive uniform joint-inference problem is not settled: uniform coverage over arbitrary changing-support and tied-face arrays remains open; the cold tier is incremental with paper_score_ceiling 4.6 below the field floor.
gap_reasons: The advertised support-adaptive uniform joint-inference problem is not settled: the note proves coverage only at fixed separated regular faces and for one engineered K=4 array, while uniform coverage over arbitrary changing-support and tied-face arrays remains the open question oeq:legal-relative-comparison.
The uniform root-n width theorem supplies no inferential validity by itself, and the singleton-cell oriented construction establishes domination only along one ray on one face.

The main novel delivered result is therefore a narrow counterexample to an even symmetric-probe proof strategy, accompanied by a face-specific repair, rather than a usable confidence procedure for the maintained class.
proof_attempt_summary: Stage D proved the finite-capacity geometry, measurable endpoint machinery, separated regular-face calibration, root-n width, and a certified K=4 diagnostic. A symmetric nearby-legal-probe argument was refuted by an explicit legal counterexample; a genuinely distinct oriented positive-part construction repaired one singleton ray but did not establish simultaneous-face domination, covariance traction, relative vanishing-scale quantile transfer, or the exact-zero-scale branch. The all-array coverage theorem was therefore removed, the global comparison retained as an open question, and the sound surviving package was graded incremental rather than field.
tldr: The accepted parent continues to identify the causal set sharply as \(\Theta_I(p)=[L(p),U(p)]\), and the proposed common-Gaussian rectangle is a well-defined measurable statistic. This note does not establish its uniform joint coverage over arbitrary triangular arrays. What is proved is exact oracle \(1-\alpha\) calibration at every fixed separated regular face, uniformly negligible fallback probability and \(O_{P_n}(n^{-1/2})\) finite-coordinate width, an explicit \(K=4\) changing-support diagnostic with exact limiting coverage, a \(K=4\) singleton-cell counterexample to every even symmetric max-linear probe satisfying both pointwise legal-envelope domination and nearby endpoint-increment domination, and a ray-restricted finite-slope oriented repair on that face. The legal-relative-comparison question is now the sole all-array inferential target. Global simultaneous-face pointwise domination, complete latent transfer with covariance traction, relative non-even lower-quantile transfer, and the exact-zero-scale branch remain unproved.
gap: The accepted parent settles sharp identification for the finite ordered survivor-complier benefit interval. Existing inference results either impose fixed-law differentiability, start from supplied asymptotically linear endpoint or standardized moment representations, or require geometric and positive-variance regularity that excludes changing support and a jointly collapsing endpoint scale.
fill: The total legal-base envelope retains every nearby support and cut face, uses one Gaussian draw for both endpoints, and seeks a scale-homogeneous comparison yielding honest coverage over all legal triangular arrays while reverting to the exact oracle rectangle on separated faces.
